translations.web: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.
translations.bsb: They were seated before Joseph in order by age, from the firstborn to the youngest, and the men looked at one another in astonishment.
translations.kjv: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
translations.asv: And they sat before him, the first-born according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one with another.
